description: Get a drop's status: URL, visibility, expiration, size, approximate view count, and its private name (if set). With an account token, owned drops need no managementToken. This reads the DROP's record, not its running app: for a graduated app's live state — is it frozen, when does its clock ring, what did the last runs do — call dropyour_schedule, which asks the app itself.
name: dropyour_status
title: Check a drop's status
